title: Tech Note: Creating a Table and Field Alias System for Multiple Users

historical_commentary.text: The specific table/field aliasing commands referenced here remain part of 4D's classic language, so this technique likely remains applicable in current 4D, though modern localization and multi-tenant schema abstraction needs are often now addressed through ORDA's more flexible data model layer rather than field-level aliasing alone.
related_updates: ORDA's data model layer (introduced in 4D v17+) offers additional, more flexible ways to present different views of underlying data to different consumers, alongside the classic field-aliasing approach described here
